title: Unveiling the Enhanced Spyglass Tool
summary: After extensive refinement, the Spyglass tool has officially launched, offering a polished and robust experience for all users.

title: Flexible File Management
summary: Gain enhanced control over your content with new features that allow you to easily manage, upload, and customize the display of all your embedded files directly within the editor.

title: Introducing Our Public Product Roadmap
summary: We are thrilled to unveil our new public roadmap, providing a clear and transparent view of recently shipped features, upcoming releases, and exciting plans for the future.

title: Intuitive Checkboxes
summary: Enjoy a seamless experience with our newly designed checkboxes, now bigger, easier to click, and effortlessly draggable.

title: Improved Collaboration Experience
summary: Collaborate more effectively than ever before with clearer indicators that make real-time teamwork effortless and intuitive.

title: Boost Your Collaborative Discovery
summary: We've made it easier than ever to find and collaborate on shared ideas and quests with your friends, enhancing discovery and teamwork.

title: Noeko is Now Open Source: Take Control!
summary: Experience unprecedented control and transparency as Noeko opens its source to empower our community and invite direct collaboration in shaping its future.

title: Global Language Support
summary: Experience Noeko in your preferred language as we introduce comprehensive international language support, connecting users worldwide.

title: Unlock More Stunning Visual Themes
summary: Get ready to elevate your workspace with a suite of refined existing themes and a spectacular array of brand-new visual styles.

title: Dynamic Knowledge Map
summary: Discover new insights and streamline your workflow with an enhanced Constellation view that offers powerful filtering by tags, time, and shared items.

title: Precision Search & Dynamic Knowledge Collections
summary: Gain ultimate control over your knowledge with advanced filtering and sorting capabilities, and easily save your refined searches as dynamic collections for future reference.

title: Interactive Note Previews
summary: Enjoy new, flexible ways to view and interact with your linked notes, making it effortless to structure your thoughts and enhance your workflow.

title: Introducing Self-Hosted Noeko and Flexible Premium Plans
summary: Experience ultimate flexibility with Noeko, as we roll out self-hosting capabilities and introduce tailored premium plans designed to meet your unique needs.

title: Enhanced Time-Aware Welcomes
summary: Experience personalized greetings that gracefully adapt to your local time, ensuring you always feel warmly welcomed at any hour.

title: Efficiently Manage Tagged Content
summary: Quickly remove items from tags or perform other essential actions directly within your tag lists, making content management faster and more intuitive.

title: Expand Your Knowledge Sources
summary: Soon, you'll be able to effortlessly integrate and analyze information from a wider range of sources, including YouTube videos, websites, and plain text, to enrich your knowledge base.
